text.en:
On Reload within 6 seconds of a Weapon Kill:
<title Refreshes [G_refresh] /> stowed weapons.

Passively grants 20 Reload Speed.

enhanced (
#e Reload Timer is increased to 7 seconds.
)

<formula Reload Time: [reload_0] />
text.zh-chs:
完成武器击杀后 6 秒内完成填装：
<title 重新填装 [G_refresh] /> 收起的武器。

被动提升 +20 填装速度。

enhanced (
#e 填装计时器增加到 7 秒。
)

text.en:
